name: Word Rave
detailed_description:
ABOUT THIS GAME

Bubble Poppin' Action Word Puzzle Like No Other

In Word Rave, you’ll clear out bad letters on a dynamic grid while rotating the board until you can form a set of words like making a big crossword. Once you're happy with the lit-up words, you’ll get to clear them in a satisfying “pop” that rewards you for bigger word combos.

Can’t Pop Stops

As you play, Stops will often clog up your board. Include them in a word that matches the board rules so they light up, then pop them away!

Use Bombs in a Word Before They Explode

Bombs will be your mini-bosses, always trying to end your game early. They’re like Stops that need to be dealt with within a certain number of pops before they explode!

Set Up Big Combos

You may want to spend some time setting up for a big pop or just to get rid of that annoying bomb. Sometimes it’s better to not score right away. When you’re patient, you can score big! And with Stars in the mix, you’ll be scoring more often for even more points!

Rave Mode is Timed

Test your speed and skill with a 3-minute timer as you race to form and pop words for the highest score. The clock is ticking, and the challenge escalates as you try to chain combos and avoid bombs that can end your run early. Can you rack up the highest score before your time is up?

Chill Mode is Endless

Take your time and play at your own pace in this relaxing yet strategically challenging mode. You’ll need to clear words such that you safely defuse bombs while the difficulty slowly ramps up. Failing to pop a bomb will lose you a heart, so try not to run out!

Daily Challenge

6x6 Chill with 3 word length? 4x4 Rave with maximum Bombs? If you’re not sure what to try or you’re looking for new ideas, check in with the Daily Challenge to play the day’s random game layout!

Scoreboard

Both modes feature high-score tracking so you can see how you stack up to your previous runes or share a screencap with your friends to see who’s the best word-popper!

Custom Games

There are thousands of possible combinations of game rules. Make your own! You can edit any of the presets to dial in your favorite ways to play. Each unique game setting has it own monthly and all-time scoreboard, too!

  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 50 MB available space
